definitions.explanation: The reduction or complete waiving of taxes, fees, penalties, or other financial obligations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{減免|げんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: To apply for a tax reduction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{減免|げんめん}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a tuition reduction/exemption system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{減免|げんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: People affected by a disaster can receive a reduction in insurance premiums.

notes:
A compound of {減|げん} (reduction) and {免|めん} (exemption) used in administrative and legal contexts. This word covers the full spectrum from partial reduction to complete waiver of financial obligations. Commonly encountered in tax forms, university tuition policies, and government aid programs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{減免|げんめん}: tax relief
- ⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧{減免|げんめん}: tuition reduction/exemption
- {減免|げんめん}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: relief measures
- {減免|げんめん}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: reduction/exemption system
- {減免|げんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a reduction/exemption

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{免除|めんじょ}→免除：05764_menjo⟧: exemption — full waiver only, no partial reduction
- ⟦{軽減|けいげん}→軽減：16954_keigen⟧: reduction/alleviation — focuses on lessening a burden, broader than financial contexts
